title: M5 Read-Before-Write Authority Extraction and Scope Governance
m5_exact_title: M5 — Executor-Neutral Runtime and CLI Dispatch
m5_primary_objective: 導入 canonical execution abstractions，並將 Hermes 整合為 adapter。
m5_entry_mode: Milestone entry / planning and canonical execution abstractions
m5_prerequisites: M4-R execution accepted, full regression suite passing with 0 failures, independent review completed and accepted, and Project Steward final M4 closure reconciliation completed
m5_owns: Canonical execution abstractions (ExecutorCapabilities, ExecutionPackage, CanonicalTaskState, CanonicalResult, RoleMapping, ExecutorAdapter)
ExecutorRegistry and Core deterministic execution dispatch
Hermes Adapter translation layer and host boundary isolation
CLI execution commands and descriptor-driven argument projection
Reference/Fake ExecutorAdapter for contract testability without live runtime
Task state reconciliation and adapter-neutral execution error taxonomy
Source ownership plan, implementation DAG, failure injection, and acceptance matrices
m5_does_not_own: Live Hermes runtime execution or live daemon management during planning/test phases
Production host deployment or supervisory infrastructure setup
Second executor (Codex) runtime implementation (owned by M6)
Redefinition of M1-M4 closed mutation semantics (plan_init, plan_retirement)
Authoritative mutation of GitHub Issue #9 governance body or control comments
m5_acceptance_criteria: same Forge execution contract can drive Hermes without legacy Core coupling
model does not manage internal execution IDs
legacy Profile Task semantics remain adapter-private
m5_runtime_boundary: Hermes is preserved as Host-only compatibility runtime. Forge Core must not require Hermes-private object identity or filesystem paths.
m5_hermes_integration_scope: Adapter-only translation layer. Translates canonical ExecutionPackage to Hermes host requests, maps canonical roles to Hermes profiles, translates Hermes status to CanonicalTaskState, maps outputs to CanonicalResult.
m5_cli_dispatch_scope: Canonical CLI machine adapter commands (aota task start/status/result/cancel, aota executor list/capabilities/select) invoking Unified Ingress / Core execution entrypoint.
m5_independent_review_requirement: PASS review required before M5 completion and known-good checkpoint advancement.
m5_downstream_milestone_contract: M5 hands off verified execution abstractions and Hermes adapter to M6 for multi-executor proof (Codex) and legacy surface reduction.
